note: Mutants for the length-limits topic's oracle and classifier self-test (scripts/topics/length-limits.cjs selfTest). `variant` mutants are the corpus's hand-made variants (research/corpus/scripts/length-examples.cjs, read without running it): the variant's edits on the cleaned corpus subject, then Ultracite's Oxlint pass until nothing changes, which is what verify would leave. Their oracle verdicts must equal examples.json's, and the functions Oxlint's line limit flags must equal the corpus's count after Oxfmt. `op` mutants are the corpus's mechanical strip and join moves on the prepared subject, as an agent would write them (`;; ` from the join on semicolon code becomes `; `). `edits` mutants are [from, to] pairs on the prepared subject. `expect`: the oracle's verdict (object key order ignored), the automatic edit reading, kinds it must include, and max-lines-per-function reports left in the user's Oxlint (inline config ignored; `handoffLeftHonor` honoured).
